meaning: Bundle elimination (#497), conditional on two open premises. McTaggart's bundle on change has two sourced commitments: no event changes in its A-series determinations, yet there are judgings and perceivings (STMT-MCTAGGART-NO-A-SERIES-CHANGE-BUT-APPEARS); and all change is A-series change (STMT-MCTAGGART-ALL-CHANGE-IS-A-SERIES-CHANGE). With Gamma = {STMT-OPINION-IS-A-MOTION, STMT-MOTION-IS-A-CHANGE} it is inconsistent: the judging it grants is a motion, hence a change, hence requires an A-series change it denies. The core does not use the premise it rivals, STMT-SOMETHING-IS-MOVED-IN-THIS-WORLD. Gamma is inclusion-minimal: models in the same Comparator config satisfy the bundle with either member alone. Closed members: none; open: both (STMT-OPINION-IS-A-MOTION sourced to Aristotle as a reputable opinion and denied by McTaggart for appearances; STMT-MOTION-IS-A-CHANGE unattributed). The config also certifies that the bundle with STMT-MOTION-IS-A-CHANGE yields the recorded McTaggart-style rival STMT-CHANGE-UNREAL-BUT-APPEARS, and that STMT-OPINION-IS-A-MOTION alone refutes that rival. No refutes relation is recorded: its premises are open (#391). It says nothing about the C series or McTaggart's later answer (The Nature of Existence II, § 511, recorded separately as STMT-MCTAGGART-APPEARINGS-DO-NOT-CHANGE), and nothing about whether time is real.
